title: verify.rs: verify_sig maps all errors to SmimeError::Other, obscuring error type
description: In verify_sig(), the error constructor is 'let e = |msg: String| SmimeError::Other(msg)'. All signature verification failures map to SmimeError::Other with a string message, even though SmimeError::SignatureVerification already exists as a dedicated unit variant. The error is then captured as a String in SignerResult.error via .to_string(). This means a signature failure in verify() produces SmimeError::AllSignersFailed whose per-signer error string says 'error: RSA sig verify: ...' (Other's Display prefix). Callers checking the error string must parse 'error: ...' rather than getting a structured SmimeError::SignatureVerification. Idiomatic approach: map signature failures to SmimeError::SignatureVerification in verify_one rather than to Other.
